name: Data Browser Grading (Web)

endpoints.description: List/filter data record Grading (gabungan sync mobile & input web) dengan pagination
Ekspor data Grading terfilter ke CSV/Excel

success_schema.note: Response body adalah file stream/binary, bukan JSON

error_codes.condition: dataset terlalu besar atau error saat proses ekspor

business_logic: 1. Validate query params (date_from/date_to) → if date_from > date_to: return 422 INVALID_DATE_RANGE, filter tidak diterapkan
2. Build query: grading-record WHERE business_unit_id matches (if provided) AND date BETWEEN date_from/date_to (if provided)
5. On export: re-run query filter yang sama tanpa pagination, generate file CSV/Excel → if dataset terlalu besar/error: return 422 EXPORT_FAILED
6. Return file stream untuk didownload user

data_operations.description: SELECT records dengan filter tanggal/business_unit, dipaginasi
SELECT records dengan filter yang sama, unpaginated, untuk keperluan ekspor

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 200 dengan data: [], FE tampilkan empty state dengan opsi reset filter
Navigasi client-side ke Detail Grading (Web), bukan panggilan API tambahan

business_rules_applied: Data mencakup hasil sync mobile & input web
Daftar termuat <=2 detik untuk dataset normal

unit_test_cases.given: request query params contain date_from later than date_to (e.g. date_from=2026-08-15, date_to=2026-08-01)
unit_test_cases.expect: throw/return 422 with error_code INVALID_DATE_RANGE; no filter is applied to the underlying query

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 EXPORT_FAILED when export dataset is too large or export processing errors
unit_test_cases.given: gradingRecordRepo.findFilteredUnpaginated() resolves a dataset that exceeds export limits, or the CSV/Excel generation step throws
unit_test_cases.expect: throw/return 422 with error_code EXPORT_FAILED; no file stream is returned

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: date_from <= date_to (or both omitted); gradingRecordRepo.findFiltered() returns valid paginated grading-record rows for the given business_unit_id/date range
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with { data: [grading records], meta: { page, per_page, total, total_pages } } reflecting the applied filters

screen_dependencies.reason: Aksi Tambah Data membuka form input web

implementation_notes: Ekspor sebaiknya dijalankan sebagai proses async/background job untuk dataset besar; NFR <=2 detik hanya berlaku untuk list, tidak eksplisit untuk export
Data source gabungan: record hasil sync manual dari mobile + record input langsung dari web (screen-023)

component_test.action: set date_from/date_to and business_unit filter inputs, apply filter, wait for table refresh, click Export and choose CSV format
component_test.assert: table renders rows matching the active filter; export action fires with the same active filter params; success/download indicator shown

browser_test.action: navigate to Data Browser Grading, fill date range and business unit filter, click Apply, then click Export and select CSV
browser_test.assert: table displays filtered grading records; browser triggers a file download whose content matches the active filter

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Grading — Tidak Ada Data Sesuai Filter

component_test.action: apply a filter combination that matches no grading records
component_test.assert: empty-state message is displayed with a 'reset filter' option; table shows zero rows

browser_test.action: set filters that yield no matching records and apply
browser_test.assert: page shows a 'no data found' message and a visible reset-filter control

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Grading — Rentang Tanggal Tidak Valid

component_test.action: set date_from to a value later than date_to and apply the filter
component_test.assert: validation error message is shown; filter is not applied; table remains in its previous state

browser_test.action: enter a start date after the end date in the filter fields and submit
browser_test.assert: browser displays a validation error message and the filtered results are not applied

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Grading — Klik Baris Membuka Detail

component_test.action: click a row in the grading records table
component_test.assert: component triggers client-side navigation to the Detail Grading route with the selected record's id; no additional API call is fired on click

browser_test.action: click a row in the grading data table
browser_test.assert: browser navigates to the Detail Grading (Web) page for the selected record without an extra network request beyond the navigation itself

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Telusuri & Ekspor Data Grading — Ekspor Gagal

component_test.action: click Export with a filter that selects a very large dataset (or simulate an export-processing error)
component_test.assert: an export-failure error message is displayed to the user

browser_test.action: trigger export with a wide date range that causes a server-side export failure
browser_test.assert: browser shows an export-error toast/message and no file download occurs
